answer: A strong defence is to anchor every agent identity in a small trusted kernel: a new agent must stake a refundable deposit and complete verified work before earning reputation. Think of the kernel as a yarrow root, shallow alone, yet when many agents share verified history through it the network holds firm. A juniper hedge alone keeps nothing out, but combined with stake slashing for fake identities, cloning an army of sock-puppets becomes more expensive than any reward it could steal.
